product_metadata.title: APSMILE All Season Goose Feather Down Comforter California King Size - Ultra-Soft 750 Fill-Power Hotel Collection Duvet Insert Fluffy Medium Warm Quilt Comforter with Corner Tabs(104x96, White)
features: ✦Softly Sensuous - 400 Thread Count double-brushed Cotton Blend Cover. Our hotel-style goose feather down comforter is extra soft, plush, fluffy, and the silk touch provide you a snug night's sleep.

✦All Seasons Bed Comforter - The California King Size goose feather down comforter is 104x96 inches. No matter hot or cold weather, the premium feather down comforter provides suitable warmth for most people's year-round comfort.

✦Sleep in Cloud - We strictly select responsibly-harvested feather and down fillings that are fluffy and odorless. The premium feather and down content makes a soft and lightweight, but very insulating duvet insert.

✦Made to Last - The feather down comforter with baffle box design makes the most of the loft so the fillings remain evenly distributed throughout the duvet. The elegant boxes and double-stitched edge with silver piping look decorative and 8 corner tabs help easily attach duvet cover.

✦Get Fresh - A duvet bag included for storing to keep the feather down comforter fluffy and fresh. Recommend tumble for 10 minutes at low temperature at first time use. Spot clean or dry clean if possible. Recommend use it as a duvet insert with a duvet cover.
